'''Virujansi''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="USW" /> in the [[Virujansi system]] of the [[Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was ruled by the [[Virujansi council]], and defended by the [[Virujansi Rarified Air Cavalry]], until the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived and replaced the council's rule with an Imperial [[governor]]. The members of the Air Cavalry were given the opportunity to join the [[Imperial Navy]], but some [[pilot]]s like [[flight leader]]<ref name="HC 71">{{HelmetCollectionCite|71|Helmets}}</ref> [[Antoc Merrick]],<ref name="TUVG" /> and his friend<ref name="MerrickDB">{{Databank|general-merrick|General Merrick}}</ref> [[Garven Dreis]]<ref name="USW" /> instead chose to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], fighting against the Empire during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TUVG" /> 

[[Hurst Romodi]], who also hailed from Virujansi,<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{C|French version only}}</ref> was a battle-scarred veteran of the [[Clone Wars]], and he became one first [[general]]s in the [[Imperial Army]],<ref name="Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> serving during pivotal Galactic Civil War battles including [[Battle of Scarif|Scarif]]<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> and [[Battle of Endor|Endor]],<ref name="To the Last">{{StoryCite|story=To the Last|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref> and as a member of the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military]].<ref name="Rise">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> 

In [[5 ABY]], the Galactic Empire finally fell to the Rebel Alliance, which reorganized into the [[New Republic]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> and by [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14}}</ref> Virujansi hosted a prison for the new [[The galaxy|galactic]] government, with the [[Quarren]] criminal [[Yath Endidee]] was serving a 40-[[standard year|year]] sentence for attempted [[death|murder]] and resisting arrest there.<ref name="Chapter 14" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Virujansi was introduced to the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''.<ref name="USW" />
